newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan ChinaTrust '96 pre-tax up 24 pct.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan ChinaTrust '96 pre-tax up 24 pct.

text.p: ChinaTrust Commercial Bank, one of Taiwan's top private banks, said on Wednesday its 1996 pre-tax profit was up 23.52 percent to T$3.634 billion, with earnings per share at T$1.99.
As of end-December 1996, the bank's total assets were T$425.144 billion, up 13.75 percent from the same period in 1995, the bank said in a statement.

The bank's total deposits rose 10.86 percent to T$331.76 billion in 1996, while loans climbed 7.35 percent to T$256.356. The bank attributed the slow growth in loans to a sluggish domestic economy and weak investment willingness.
It said credit card business was booming. The number of credit cards issued by the bank grew 16.55 percent to 1.3 million in 1996 from a year ago.
